blocks.content: In programming, we frequently deal with lots of data, so arrays are almost always used in those cases.
So, it's important to have a good grasp of arrays.
To help you understand arrays with more clarity, here're some of the array based examples which we will cover in this lesson.

items: Find the largest element in an array
Practice: Find the smallest element in an array
Practice: Multiply all elements of an array by 10
